commit: fix(runtime-core): properly diff slot node and fallback node

truth.description: renderSlot, the only code that sets isSlotFallback, now sets it only to true and leaves it undefined on a fragment with content, so the new check in processFragment, which needs both sides defined and different, can never pass, and a slot that switches between its content and its fallback still takes the broken patch path.

distractions.why: Only the fallback function assigns block, and it runs only when the slot renders no content, so block still holds the null that beforeEach set while the content shows.
